items.q: What are love games for couples?
items.a: Love games are interactive games - like truth or dare, would you rather, or spin the wheel - designed to help couples connect, communicate, and have fun together. They range from light and playful to deep and intimate.

items.q: Are the games on Mioshy free?
items.a: Yes! All core couples games on Mioshy are completely free. No account needed, no app download - just open and play.

items.q: Can we play these games on a virtual date night?
items.a: Absolutely. All Mioshy games work perfectly over video call - just share your screen and take turns. Great for long-distance couples.

items.q: Are there spicy or adults-only versions?
items.a: Yes. We have dedicated adults-only game modes for couples who want to turn up the heat. They are clearly marked and separate from our standard games.

items.q: How long does a typical couples game session last?
items.a: Most couples play for 30–60 minutes, but you can go as long as you like - there are hundreds of questions and challenges in each game.
